lessons.name: Semantic HTML
lessons.desc: Using the right element for meaning: header, nav, main, article, section, aside, footer.
lessons.q: Why does semantic HTML matter? What do you lose by building everything with divs?
lessons.qsub: Which elements would you use to mark up a blog post page, and why?

lessons.name: Document Structure & Metadata
lessons.desc: doctype, html lang, head vs body, meta charset, viewport, title, link/script placement.
lessons.q: Walk me through the essential contents of a <head>. Why does the viewport meta tag matter?
lessons.qsub: What is the difference between placing a <script> in head vs end of body vs using defer?

lessons.name: Forms & Input Types
lessons.desc: form, label association, input types (email, number, date, etc.), name/value, method/action.
lessons.q: How do you correctly associate a label with an input, and why does it matter?
lessons.qsub: What is the difference between GET and POST form submission?

lessons.name: Native Form Validation
lessons.desc: required, pattern, min/max, type-based validation, :valid/:invalid, Constraint Validation API.
lessons.q: How does native HTML form validation work? When would you override it with JS?
lessons.qsub: How do you style a field based on its validity state without JavaScript?

lessons.name: Images & Media (img, picture, srcset, video)
lessons.desc: alt text, responsive images via srcset/sizes, <picture> art direction, lazy loading, video/audio.
lessons.q: How do srcset and sizes work? How would you serve different images to mobile vs desktop?
lessons.qsub: What does loading="lazy" do and what are its caveats?

lessons.name: Accessibility Roles & ARIA
lessons.desc: Semantic-first accessibility, ARIA roles/states/properties, when ARIA is needed vs harmful, focus management.
lessons.q: What is the first rule of ARIA? When should you reach for aria-* attributes?
lessons.qsub: How do you make a custom div-based button fully accessible?

lessons.name: Script Loading — async vs defer
lessons.desc: Render-blocking scripts, async (load+run ASAP), defer (run after parse, in order), module scripts.
lessons.q: What is the difference between async and defer? Which would you use for a third-party analytics script?
lessons.qsub: Why can a <script> in the <head> hurt First Contentful Paint?

lessons.name: data-* Attributes & the DOM
lessons.desc: Custom data-* attributes, dataset API, when to use them vs classes or JS state.
lessons.q: What are data-* attributes for? How do you read them in JavaScript?
lessons.qsub: When is a data attribute the wrong tool for holding state?

units.title: CSS Core — Selectors, Cascade, Box Model

lessons.name: Selectors & Combinators
lessons.desc: Type, class, id, attribute selectors; descendant, child (>), sibling (+, ~) combinators; :is()/:where().
lessons.q: Explain the different CSS combinators with examples. What does :where() add over :is()?
lessons.qsub: What is the difference between .a .b and .a > .b?

lessons.name: Specificity & the Cascade
lessons.desc: How the browser resolves conflicting rules: specificity (id > class > type), source order, importance.
lessons.q: How is CSS specificity calculated? How would you resolve two rules fighting over the same element?
lessons.qsub: Where does !important sit in the cascade, and why is it a code smell?

lessons.name: Inheritance & initial/inherit/unset
lessons.desc: Which properties inherit (color, font) vs not (margin, border); inherit, initial, unset, revert keywords.
lessons.q: Which CSS properties inherit by default and which do not? How do you force inheritance?
lessons.qsub: What is the difference between unset and revert?

lessons.name: The Box Model & box-sizing
lessons.desc: Content, padding, border, margin; content-box vs border-box; why border-box is the sane default.
lessons.q: Explain the CSS box model. What does box-sizing: border-box change and why do people set it globally?
lessons.qsub: A div has width:200px, padding:20px, border:5px. How wide is it in each box-sizing mode?

lessons.name: Display: block / inline / inline-block
lessons.desc: How elements flow: block (full width), inline (no box dimensions), inline-block (box + inline flow).
lessons.q: What is the difference between block, inline, and inline-block? Give a use case for each.
lessons.qsub: Why can you not set width/height on a pure inline element?

lessons.name: Margin Collapsing
lessons.desc: Adjacent vertical margins collapse to the larger value; when it happens and how to prevent it.
lessons.q: What is margin collapsing? Show a case where it surprises developers.
lessons.qsub: How do you stop two vertical margins from collapsing?

lessons.name: Units — px, em, rem, %, vw/vh, ch
lessons.desc: Absolute vs relative units; em (relative to parent font-size) vs rem (root); viewport and content units.
lessons.q: What is the difference between em and rem? When would you choose each?
lessons.qsub: Why can nested em values compound unexpectedly?

lessons.name: CSS Custom Properties (Variables)
lessons.desc: --var declarations, var() with fallbacks, scoping/cascade, runtime theming, contrast with Sass variables.
lessons.q: How do CSS custom properties differ from Sass variables? Why are they powerful for theming?
lessons.qsub: How would you implement a runtime dark-mode toggle using CSS variables?

lessons.name: Flexbox — Main/Cross Axis
lessons.desc: flex container vs items, main/cross axis, justify-content, align-items, align-content, flex-direction.
lessons.q: Explain the flexbox axes. How do justify-content and align-items differ?
lessons.qsub: How do you vertically and horizontally center a single element with flexbox?

lessons.name: flex-grow / shrink / basis
lessons.desc: The flex shorthand; how items distribute free space; flex-basis vs width; flex:1 meaning.
lessons.q: What does flex: 1 expand to and what does it actually do?
lessons.qsub: What is the difference between flex-basis and width?

lessons.name: CSS Grid — Tracks & Placement
lessons.desc: grid-template-columns/rows, fr unit, repeat(), gap, minmax(), auto-fit vs auto-fill.
lessons.q: When would you choose Grid over Flexbox? Explain fr and minmax().
lessons.qsub: What is the difference between auto-fit and auto-fill in repeat()?

lessons.name: Grid Template Areas & Line Placement
lessons.desc: Named grid-template-areas, grid-column/row line placement, spanning, implicit vs explicit grid.
lessons.q: How do grid-template-areas work? When are they clearer than line-based placement?
lessons.qsub: What is the implicit grid and how does grid-auto-flow affect it?

lessons.name: Positioning — static/relative/absolute/fixed/sticky
lessons.desc: Normal flow vs positioned; containing block; offsets; sticky = relative until threshold then fixed.
lessons.q: Explain each position value. What is the containing block for an absolutely positioned element?
lessons.qsub: How does position: sticky decide when to stick, and why does it sometimes silently not work?

lessons.name: z-index & Stacking Contexts
lessons.desc: What creates a stacking context (position+z-index, opacity, transform), why z-index:9999 can fail.
lessons.q: Why can a z-index: 9999 element still appear behind another? Explain stacking contexts.
lessons.qsub: Name three properties (other than z-index) that create a new stacking context.

lessons.name: Centering Techniques
lessons.desc: Flex/grid centering, margin auto, absolute + transform, when each applies.
lessons.q: Give me three ways to center a box both horizontally and vertically. Trade-offs of each?
lessons.qsub: How do you center an element of unknown width and height?

lessons.name: Float & Clear (legacy)
lessons.desc: Historical layout with floats, clearfix hack, why floats caused collapsing parents.
lessons.q: What were floats originally for and why did they get abused for layout?
lessons.qsub: What is a clearfix and why was it needed?

lessons.name: Container Queries
lessons.desc: @container queries size components by their container, not the viewport — true component responsiveness.
lessons.q: How do container queries differ from media queries? Why are they a big deal for design systems?
lessons.qsub: What is a containment context and how do you set one up?

lessons.name: Media Queries
lessons.desc: min-width/max-width breakpoints, feature queries, orientation, prefers-color-scheme / reduced-motion.
lessons.q: How do media queries work? What does prefers-reduced-motion let you do?
lessons.qsub: What is the difference between min-width and max-width breakpoint strategies?

lessons.name: Mobile-First Strategy
lessons.desc: Base styles for small screens, layer up with min-width; why it produces simpler, faster CSS.
lessons.q: What does mobile-first mean in practice? Why is it preferred over desktop-first?
lessons.qsub: How does mobile-first reduce CSS overrides?

lessons.name: Fluid Type & clamp()
lessons.desc: clamp(min, preferred, max) for fluid font sizes and spacing without breakpoints.
lessons.q: How does clamp() work? Write a fluid font-size that scales between 16px and 24px.
lessons.qsub: Why is clamp() often better than a stack of media queries for typography?

lessons.name: Responsive Images (srcset / sizes)
lessons.desc: Serving right-sized images per viewport/DPR, sizes attribute, <picture> for art direction, aspect-ratio.
lessons.q: How do you avoid shipping a 2000px image to a phone? Explain srcset + sizes.
lessons.qsub: How does the aspect-ratio property help prevent layout shift for images?

lessons.name: Viewport Units & Mobile Gotchas
lessons.desc: vw/vh/vmin/vmax, the mobile 100vh address-bar problem, dvh/svh/lvh dynamic units.
lessons.q: Why does 100vh behave badly on mobile browsers, and how do dvh/svh fix it?
lessons.qsub: When would you use vmin or vmax?

lessons.name: Typography Control
lessons.desc: font shorthand, line-height, letter-spacing, font stacks/fallbacks, web-safe fonts, text-wrap: balance.
lessons.q: What makes body text readable? Talk about line-height, measure, and font fallbacks.
lessons.qsub: What does a good font-family fallback stack look like and why?

lessons.name: Overflow & Text Truncation
lessons.desc: overflow visible/hidden/scroll/auto, single-line ellipsis, multi-line line-clamp.
lessons.q: How do you truncate a single line of text with an ellipsis? What about multi-line?
lessons.qsub: Why does text-overflow: ellipsis require white-space and overflow to also be set?

lessons.name: Pseudo-classes (:hover, :focus, :nth-child)
lessons.desc: State selectors, structural pseudo-classes, :focus-visible vs :focus, :not(), functional pseudo-classes.
lessons.q: What is the difference between :focus and :focus-visible? Why does it matter for accessibility?
lessons.qsub: How would you style every third item in a list?

lessons.name: Pseudo-elements (::before / ::after)
lessons.desc: Generated content, the content property, decorative shapes, icons, and layout tricks.
lessons.q: What is the difference between a pseudo-class and a pseudo-element?
lessons.qsub: Give a practical use of ::before or ::after you have actually used.

lessons.name: Backgrounds & Gradients
lessons.desc: background shorthand, multiple backgrounds, linear/radial/conic gradients, background-size/position.
lessons.q: How do you layer multiple backgrounds? What is the difference between cover and contain?
lessons.qsub: How would you create a subtle striped background with a single gradient?

lessons.name: Borders, Radius & Shadows
lessons.desc: border-radius, box-shadow (inset, spread), drop-shadow filter vs box-shadow, outline vs border.
lessons.q: What is the difference between box-shadow and filter: drop-shadow? When does each matter?
lessons.qsub: Why should you never remove focus outlines without providing an alternative?

lessons.name: CSS Transitions
lessons.desc: transition-property/duration/timing-function/delay, which properties are animatable, easing curves.
lessons.q: How does a CSS transition work? Which properties are cheap to animate and which are expensive?
lessons.qsub: Why does transition: all can be a performance foot-gun?

lessons.name: Keyframe Animations
lessons.desc: @keyframes, animation shorthand, iteration, direction, fill-mode, play-state.
lessons.q: How do @keyframes differ from transitions? When would you reach for each?
lessons.qsub: What does animation-fill-mode: forwards do?

lessons.name: Transforms (translate / scale / rotate)
lessons.desc: 2D/3D transforms, transform-origin, why transforms do not trigger layout, will-change.
lessons.q: Why is animating transform smoother than animating top/left?
lessons.qsub: What does transform-origin control and when do you change it?

lessons.name: Animation Performance (compositor-friendly)
lessons.desc: Animate only transform & opacity to stay on the compositor; avoid layout/paint thrash; will-change budget.
lessons.q: Which two properties can you animate without triggering layout or paint, and why?
lessons.qsub: What does will-change do and why should you use it sparingly?

lessons.name: Critical Rendering Path
lessons.desc: DOM + CSSOM → render tree → layout → paint → composite; render-blocking CSS/JS; how the browser paints.
lessons.q: Walk me through how the browser turns HTML and CSS into pixels on screen.
lessons.qsub: Why is CSS render-blocking, and how do you reduce that cost?

lessons.name: Reflow vs Repaint vs Composite
lessons.desc: Layout (reflow) recalculates geometry; paint fills pixels; composite layers GPU-blend. Which props trigger which.
lessons.q: What is the difference between reflow, repaint, and composite? Which is most expensive?
lessons.qsub: Give three property changes that force a reflow and three that only repaint.

lessons.name: Layout Thrashing & Batching
lessons.desc: Forced synchronous layout from read-after-write in JS; batching reads then writes; requestAnimationFrame.
lessons.q: What is layout thrashing? How do you avoid forced synchronous layout in a loop?
lessons.qsub: Which DOM reads force a synchronous layout flush?

lessons.name: Core Web Vitals (LCP / CLS / INP)
lessons.desc: Largest Contentful Paint, Cumulative Layout Shift, Interaction to Next Paint; targets and common fixes.
lessons.q: What are the Core Web Vitals and what causes a poor score in each?
lessons.qsub: How would you diagnose and fix a high CLS on a page?

lessons.name: Web Font Loading (FOUT / FOIT)
lessons.desc: font-display swap/optional, preloading fonts, fallback metrics, layout shift from font swaps.
lessons.q: What is the difference between FOUT and FOIT? How does font-display control it?
lessons.qsub: How do you prevent a layout shift when a web font finishes loading?

lessons.name: CSS Containment & content-visibility
lessons.desc: contain property, content-visibility: auto to skip offscreen rendering, performance isolation.
lessons.q: What does content-visibility: auto do for a long page?
lessons.qsub: What kinds of containment does the contain property offer?

lessons.name: Naming Methodologies (BEM)
lessons.desc: BEM block__element--modifier, why naming conventions fight specificity and scale in large codebases.
lessons.q: What problem does BEM solve? How does it keep specificity flat?
lessons.qsub: What are the trade-offs of BEM versus utility-first CSS?

lessons.name: CSS Modules & Scoping
lessons.desc: Locally scoped class names, hashing, composition; solving the global namespace problem.
lessons.q: How do CSS Modules prevent class-name collisions? What does the build step do?
lessons.qsub: How does composes work in CSS Modules?

lessons.name: CSS-in-JS (styled-components / emotion)
lessons.desc: Runtime vs zero-runtime CSS-in-JS, dynamic styling from props, SSR concerns, performance trade-offs.
lessons.q: What are the pros and cons of CSS-in-JS? What is the runtime cost?
lessons.qsub: Why have zero-runtime solutions (Linaria, vanilla-extract) gained popularity?

lessons.name: Utility-First CSS (Tailwind)
lessons.desc: Utility classes, design tokens via config, purge/JIT, when utility-first helps or hurts maintainability.
lessons.q: What is the case for and against Tailwind / utility-first CSS?
lessons.qsub: How does Tailwind keep the shipped CSS small?

lessons.name: Design Tokens & Theming (dark mode)
lessons.desc: Token layers, CSS variables for theming, prefers-color-scheme, per-component theming without JS.
lessons.q: How would you architect a themeable design system that supports light/dark and brand themes?
lessons.qsub: Why are CSS variables better than duplicated stylesheets for theming?

lessons.name: Preprocessors (Sass) & @layer
lessons.desc: Sass nesting/mixins/functions, native CSS nesting, cascade layers (@layer) for predictable ordering.
lessons.q: What do preprocessors still offer now that CSS has variables and nesting?
lessons.qsub: What problem do CSS cascade layers (@layer) solve?
